page_title: EKHOS AI: Unlimited Offline Transcription for Windows

sources.entry: 24. EKHOS AI - A powerful speech-to-text software that transcribes audio and video files, supports real-time recording and transcription, and includes a built-in proofreading editor.

summary.name: EKHOS AI
summary.one_liner: EKHOS AI is an offline, privacy-focused speech-to-text application for Windows that transcribes audio and video files on the user's own computer.
use_cases: Transcribing legal or healthcare recordings privately
Transcribing research interviews on a local PC
Batch transcribing a queue of audio or video files
Exporting transcripts to Word, PDF or text
summary.what_it_does: EKHOS AI transcribes audio and video files such as MP3, MP4, WAV, MKV, AVI and MPEG, with speaker identification and labeling. It can also record and transcribe microphone or speaker audio, with transcription starting after a configurable delay (default 1 minute). Processing runs locally on the CPU or an NVIDIA GPU, and the page says transcripts and files are not sent externally. A built-in media player and Tracks Editor highlight segments in sync with playback so users can correct text, with search and a plain text editor as alternatives. Transcripts can be exported to Word, PDF or text, or copied to the clipboard.
notable: Runs fully offline with local AI and no telemetry, per the page
Unlimited transcription with no stated limits on file size, quantity or duration
Tracks Editor syncs transcript segments with audio or video playback
caveats: Requires an account sign-up and email verification before installing the app
NVIDIA GPU acceleration is mentioned; hardware requirements are on a separate page and were not read
A free plan is mentioned in the meta description, but its limits are not described on the page
